notes.title: HTC Vive Issues
notes.notes:
We've recently been made aware of issues Throne of the Dead has playing on the HTC Vive. We are currently working on a fix for this and will update the game as soon as possible. 

We hope to get you all defending your Thrones soon enough!

notes.title: FREE Halloween DLC incoming!
notes.notes:
Don your scariest costume and prepare for the onslaught that is Throne of the Dead's Halloween DLC! 

Face off pumpkin headed hordes and un-dead campers across two all new maps, Graveyard and Camp Site! 

Along with 6 more stars to master, you also get three spooky skins to unlock: Ghost, Skeleton and Pumpkin! 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30291546/e54bde32de3407c1151b8ebfb8b4c9b700f84534.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30291546/2e5bee8cbe0c7b63a63362f4b1d09fd25baf1ccb.png[/img]

In addition to this, the entire game will receive a creepy face-lift. Starting October 15th and lasting until November 2nd, everything in the game will be Halloween themed! Everything! You'll be glad you're already on the throne for this one! 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30291546/5d708f16d9e914a3ccba9aea2d212f40d39c726d.png[/img]

The Halloween DLC rises out of the grave this October for everyone!

notes.title: Upcoming DLC, Features and Updates!
notes.notes:
Hello to all Potty-Brained Throne Protectors out there! This is just a quick update to let you know what's to come for Throne of the Dead in the coming weeks and months. 

Our plan for Throne of the Dead is to keep it updated regularly, this can range from simple bug fixes, tweaks or even new features and DLC. As such, the following are features that we plan on adding sometime in the future: 

- Boss Waves
- More variation of Zombie Types
- A Wider Range of Power Ups, including More Guns! 

We won't provide a definitive date as to when these features will be added as we don't want to make any false promises. But rest assured they will be coming, and with more details soon!

We'd also like to take this opportunity to announce our upcoming DLC for Throne of the Dead. The Halloween DLC and Christmas DLC. Both DLC's will go live in October and December respectively. 

Both of these DLC's will be completely free for anyone who owns the base game! We will have more details on the Halloween DLC very soon!
